mapper.select: SELECT A.REG_MONTH_INQUIRY AS VISIT_MONTH, COUNT(A.ID) AS CNT FROM VISITOR_HISTORY A INNER JOIN ( SELECT ID FROM VISITOR_HISTORY WHERE VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID = #{memId} AND REG_YEAR_INQUIRY = DATE_FORMAT(#{searchDate}, '%Y') GROUP BY REG_DATE_INQUIRY, CLIENT_IP, VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID ) B ON B.ID = A.ID GROUP BY A.REG_MONTH_INQUIRY

SELECT A.REG_DATE_INQUIRY AS VISIT_DATE , COUNT(A.ID) AS CNT FROM VISITOR_HISTORY A INNER JOIN ( SELECT ID FROM VISITOR_HISTORY WHERE VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID = #{memId} AND REG_MONTH_INQUIRY = DATE_FORMAT(#{searchDate}, '%Y%m') GROUP BY REG_DATE_INQUIRY, CLIENT_IP, VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID ) B ON B.ID = A.ID GROUP BY REG_DATE_INQUIRY

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT ID FROM VISITOR_HISTORY WHERE VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID IN(#{memId}) AND ACCESS_TARGET IN ('naver','daum','yahoo','google','zoom','local') GROUP BY REG_DATE_INQUIRY, CLIENT_IP, VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID, ACCESS_TARGET ) A ) AS ALL_CNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT ID FROM VISITOR_HISTORY WHERE VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID IN(#{memId}) AND ACCESS_TARGET IN (#{item}) GROUP BY REG_DATE_INQUIRY, CLIENT_IP, VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID, ACCESS_TARGET ) A ) AS ${item}_CNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT ID FROM VISITOR_HISTORY WHERE VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID IN(#{memId}) AND ACCESS_TARGET NOT IN
#{item}
GROUP BY REG_DATE_INQUIRY, CLIENT_IP, VISIT_STORY_MEM_ID, ACCESS_TARGET ) A ) AS ETC_CNT FROM DUAL
